purpose: Validation-only screening of a Bi-Mamba+ inspired bidirectional patch Mamba with an exact AutoCon null across four datasets.
research_question: Can a channel-preserving bidirectional patch Mamba retain short-horizon accuracy against strong baselines while keeping the AutoCon representation directly connected to the forecast path?
architecture: BiPatchMamba uses non-overlapping patch tokens and a bidirectional Mamba-1 pair over the variable-token axis. Its AutoCon representation is derived from the same encoded patch states and contributes a zero-initialized forecast correction.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory screen. No held-out test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass only licenses a later frozen confirmation protocol; it does not establish universal Mamba superiority or a universal speed advantage.
prelaunch_gates: verify all four dataset SHA256 fingerprints and registered multivariate dimensions
verify exact BiPatch plain/null/active graph pairing with fresh seeds
verify AutoCon representation and zero-initialized forecast correction share encoded states
verify six external baselines disable all candidate-only options
verify exact-shape prediction-only resource preflights before launch
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job

resource_preflight.protocol: RTX 5090 D, FP32, device-resident B=32/L=96/H=12, 50 warm-up and 200 timed prediction-only forwards; auxiliary representation disabled.
resource_preflight.interpretation: Resource rows are load measurements, not forecasting replicates. The candidate may be compared only to explicitly measured same-shape models.

phases.name: bipatch_autocon_null_h12
phases.purpose: Exact AutoCon-capable BiPatch graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: bipatch_autocon_active_h12
phases.purpose: BiPatchMamba with active AutoCon representation objective.

comparison_contract.accuracy_gate: For each dataset, active must be within 2% of the strongest external baseline mean; a transfer pass requires all four datasets.
comparison_contract.autocon_gate: Active must be within 1% of exact null. An improvement claim additionally requires lower mean MSE and both paired seed wins in this two-seed screen.
comparison_contract.resource_gate: Report exact-shape prediction-only latency and parameters; no universal speed wording is allowed.

stopping_rules: Do not alter architecture, patching, Mamba settings, lambda, optimizer, split, seeds, or epoch budget after launch.
Stop this transfer branch if any dataset fails the external-baseline gate.
Do not claim a standalone AutoCon gain if its exact null contrast fails.
Do not remove or replace a baseline after launch.
